# dotnet-inspect

CLI tool for inspecting .NET libraries and NuGet packages. It is for .NET what `docker inspect` and `kubectl describe` are for container land.

It operates on three types of content:

- **Platform libraries** — e.g., `System.Collections` (shipped with the .NET SDK)
- **NuGet packages** — e.g., `Microsoft.Extensions.AI`
- **Local paths** — e.g., `path/to/library.dll` or `path/to/package.nupkg`

```bash
dotnet-inspect Microsoft.Extensions.AI              # Bare name — routes to best resource
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json             # Package metadata
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json             # Library metadata
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json   # Library metadata from a NuGet package
dotnet-inspect type --package System.Text.Json      # Discover types
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json  # Inspect members
dotnet-inspect find "Chat*,Diction*"                # Search types across scopes
dotnet-inspect diff System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0  # API version comparison
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient                # Extension methods
dotnet-inspect implements Stream                    # Interface implementers
dotnet-inspect depends 'INumber<TSelf>'              # Type/package/library dependency graph
dotnet-inspect samples Markout MarkoutWriter        # Code samples
dotnet-inspect demo list                            # Curated showcase queries
```

## Core Concepts

### Resources: Library vs Package

A **library** and a **package** are different resources with different data:

- **Library** — a single assembly (.dll). Shows assembly-level metadata: version, target framework, compilation flags, signing, file size, type/method counts.
- **Package** — a NuGet package (a bundle of libraries + other content). Shows package-level metadata: license, repository, content breakdown, target framework count, readme.

The same name (e.g., `System.Text.Json`) can refer to either. Use explicit commands to choose:

```bash
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json             # Assembly metadata (platform)
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json   # Assembly metadata (from NuGet)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json             # NuGet package metadata
```

### Bare Name Router

A bare name like `dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json` uses a router to pick the best resource. Platform libraries are always preferred over NuGet packages when both exist:

```bash
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json      # → library (platform — Source: Platform)
dotnet-inspect System.CommandLine    # → package (not in platform — Source: NuGet)
```

The `Source` field in the output confirms which was chosen. To override, use explicit commands: `package System.Text.Json` or `library --package System.Text.Json`.

### Four Formatters

Output is rendered by one of four formatters: **plaintext** (default), **markdown**, **oneline**, **json**.

```bash
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json                     # plaintext (field/value pairs)
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json --markdown           # markdown tables
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json --oneline            # columnar table
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json --json               # JSON
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json --plaintext          # explicit plaintext
```

Each command picks a sensible default formatter. Help output is plaintext, not a separate formatter.

### Verbosity Controls Sections, Not Formatting

Verbosity (`-v`) controls which sections are included. Each level adds more:

| Flag | Level | What's included |
| ---- | ----- | --------------- |
| `-v:q` | Quiet | Heading + compact summary line |
| `-v:m` | Minimal | + main info section |
| `-v:n` | Normal | + all sections that don't require the network |
| `-v:d` | Detailed | + all sections, including network-dependent ones (symbols, source link) |

### Verbosity and Formatter Are Orthogonal

Verbosity controls *which sections*. Formatter controls *how sections render*. They compose freely:

```bash
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:q                 # quiet + markdown (default formatter for -v)
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:q --plaintext     # quiet + plaintext
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:n --plaintext     # normal sections + plaintext aligned columns
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:q --json          # quiet + JSON
```

`-v` defaults to the markdown formatter. You can override with an explicit formatter flag.

**Exception:** `--oneline` and `-v` cannot be combined — oneline can only show one section at a time.

### Structured Queries (like Go templates, without a DSL)

Instead of a template DSL, the tool provides flags to discover the schema and project specific fields:

```bash
# Discover what's available
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -D                   # list all possible sections
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -D Symbols           # list fields within a section
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -D --effective       # list sections that have data (dry run)
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -D --tree    # full schema tree (sections → fields/columns)

# Select and project
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -S Symbols           # render a specific section
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -S Symbols --fields "PDB*, Source*"  # project specific fields
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json --columns Kind,Type  # project specific columns
```

- **`-D`** (discover) — introspect the schema. Shows sections, or fields/columns within a section. Add `--effective` to see only sections that have data for this artifact. Add `--tree` to see the full hierarchy.
- **`-S`** (select) — render a specific section by name (comma-separated, glob-capable).
- **`--fields`** — project specific fields in field/value views (glob-capable).
- **`--columns`** — project specific columns in tabular views (glob-capable).

### Filtering and Limiting

```bash
# Kind filter — works at both type and member level
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -k enum         # filter to enum types
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -k interface    # filter to interfaces
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -k method   # filter to methods within a type
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -k property # filter to properties

# Type and member filters
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -t "*Converter*"  # glob filter on type names
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument -m Parse  # filter to members by name
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument -m 'Deseri*'  # glob member filter

# Line limit (like head)
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -n 5            # first 5 lines
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -5              # shorthand (like head -5)

# Item limit
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -m 3  # limit to 3 members per kind
```

- **`-n N` or `-N`** — limits output *lines* (like `head`).
- **`-m N`** (numeric) — limits *items* (members per kind section).
- **`-m Name`** (string) — filters by member name (supports globs).
- **`-k`** — filters by kind. On all-types view: `class`, `struct`, `interface`, `enum`, `delegate`. On single-type view: `method`, `property`, `field`, `event`, `constructor`.
- **`-t`** — filters types by glob pattern.

### Tips

Contextual suggestions on stderr, like `tip: a similar subcommand exists: 'list'` in other CLI tools. Tips suggest logical next commands based on what you just ran.

```bash
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -T:d   # more tips
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -T:q   # suppress tips
dotnet-inspect System.Text.Json -v:q   # quiet verbosity also suppresses tips
DOTNET_INSPECT_TIPS=quiet              # ENV-based suppression
```

### Self-Describing Commands

```bash
dotnet-inspect llmstxt               # comprehensive reference (this file)
dotnet-inspect skill                 # skill definition for agent/MCP integration
```

## Commands

### package

Inspect NuGet packages — metadata, files, versions, dependencies.

```bash
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json                     # Metadata (latest version)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json 8.0.0               # Specific version (positional)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json@8.0.0               # Specific version (@ syntax)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --version 8.0.0     # Specific version (flag)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json -v:d                # Detailed — all sections
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json -v:q                # Quiet — compact line
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json@8.0.0 -S "Vulnerabilities"  # Select section
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --tfm net8.0 -v:d   # Filter to TFM
```

Package data queries:

```bash
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --versions          # List available versions
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --version           # Show latest version
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --version 11.0.0-preview*  # Wildcard version
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --files             # File listing
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --tfms              # TFM list
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --layout            # Tree view of files
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --layout --lib      # Tree view filtered to lib/
dotnet-inspect package dotnet-inspect --layout --tools      # Tree view for tool packages
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --dependencies      # Package dependency tree
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --tfm net9.0 --dependencies  # Dependencies for specific TFM
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --readme            # Show README.md from package
```

Custom NuGet sources:

```bash
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --version 11.0.0-preview* \
  --add-source https://dnceng.pkgs.visualstudio.com/public/_packaging/dotnet11/nuget/v3/index.json --prerelease
dotnet-inspect package MyPackage --source https://my-feed/v3/index.json
dotnet-inspect package MyPackage --nugetconfig ./nuget.config
```

Package search (NuGet discovery):

```bash
dotnet-inspect package search "Azure.AI"               # Search NuGet by keyword
dotnet-inspect package search "AWSSDK" --take 20       # Limit results
dotnet-inspect package search "Aspire" --json          # JSON output
```

### library

Inspect a library — metadata, symbols, references, dependencies, resources.

```bash
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json                     # Platform library (runtime)
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json            # Library from NuGet package
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json -v:q       # Compact line
dotnet-inspect library ./bin/MyLib.dll                       # Local file
```

Key features:

```bash
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json --references                    # Direct references
dotnet-inspect library Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI --dependencies   # Dependency tree
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json --source-link-audit  # SourceLink provenance audit
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json --extract-resources resources/  # Extract resources
dotnet-inspect library --package System.Text.Json -S Resources         # View embedded resources
```

Schema discovery:

```bash
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -D                  # List all possible sections
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -D --effective      # List sections with data
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -D --tree           # Full schema tree (sections → fields/columns)
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -D Symbols          # List fields in Symbols section
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -S Symbols          # Render Symbols section
dotnet-inspect library System.Text.Json -S Symbols --fields "PDB*"  # Project specific fields
```

### type

Discover types in a package or library. Two modes depending on scope:

**All types** — oneline table by default:

```bash
dotnet-inspect type --package System.Text.Json                   # All types (oneline table)
dotnet-inspect type --platform System.Text.Json                  # From platform
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json                             # Bare name — auto-routes
dotnet-inspect type -t "JsonS*" --package System.Text.Json       # Filter by glob
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -k enum                     # Filter by kind
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json -5                          # First 5 lines
```

**Single type** — tree/shape view by default:

```bash
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument                # Tree view (positional args)
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json.JsonDocument                # Tree view (fully qualified)
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument --oneline      # Columnar table
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument --markdown     # Markdown tables per kind
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -k method      # Methods only
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -m Parse       # Filter to Parse members
dotnet-inspect type System.Text.Json JsonDocument -m 3           # Limit to 3 members per kind
dotnet-inspect type 'HashSet<T>' --platform System.Collections   # Generic types (quote!)
```

### member

Inspect type members — docs on by default, default output is oneline.

```bash
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument              # All members (oneline table)
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json.JsonDocument              # Fully qualified
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json  # From NuGet package
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --no-docs  # Suppress docs
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Serialize  # Filter to member
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m 'Deseri*'  # Glob filter
dotnet-inspect member -m JsonSerializer.Deserialize --package System.Text.Json  # Dotted syntax
dotnet-inspect member -m System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse --platform System.Text.Json  # Fully qualified dotted
dotnet-inspect member 'Option<T>' --package System.CommandLine   # Generic types (quote!)
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine --ctor  # Constructors (shorthand for -m .ctor)
```

Drilling into overloads — use `--select` to see `Name:N` indices, then target one:

```bash
dotnet-inspect member OptionsFactory --package Microsoft.Extensions.Options --select  # Show Name:N indices
dotnet-inspect member OptionsFactory --package Microsoft.Extensions.Options Create:1  # Drill into overload
dotnet-inspect member OptionsFactory --package Microsoft.Extensions.Options -m .ctor --params "IEnumerable<...>,IEnumerable<...>"  # By param types
```

When targeting a single overload, the tool fetches source via SourceLink and produces four views:

```bash
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument Parse:1 -v:d
# Source               — original C# (via SourceLink)
# Lowered C#           — decompiled C# faithful to IL semantics
# IL                   — raw IL disassembly with resolved tokens
# IL (Annotated)       — IL with pre-execution stack state at each instruction
```

Markdown output expands all overloads with full signatures:

```bash
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument -v:m      # Markdown with full signatures
dotnet-inspect member System.Text.Json JsonDocument -v:d      # Markdown + source/IL sections
```

### find

Search for types across packages, frameworks, and local assets. Supports glob patterns and fuzzy matching.

```bash
dotnet-inspect find INumber*                             # Glob pattern (exact match)
dotnet-inspect find IChatClient                          # No glob — fuzzy match with SIM column
dotnet-inspect find "*Stream*" -n 10                     # Limit results
dotnet-inspect find "*Json*" --package System.Text.Json  # Search in package
dotnet-inspect find IChatClient --extensions              # Microsoft.Extensions packages
dotnet-inspect find "*Logger*" --platform                 # All platform frameworks
dotnet-inspect find "*Command*" --project ./MyApp.csproj  # Project dependencies
dotnet-inspect find "*Service*" --bin ./bin/Debug/net8.0   # Built output directory
```

Batch search (comma-separated patterns):

```bash
dotnet-inspect find "Chat*,Diction*"
dotnet-inspect find "Option*,Argument*,Command*" --package System.CommandLine
```

| Scope | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| (none) | Default scope (all platform frameworks + Microsoft.Extensions.AI) |
| `--platform` | All platform frameworks (runtime, aspnetcore, netstandard) |
| `--extensions` | Curated Microsoft.Extensions.* packages |
| `--aspnetcore` | Curated Microsoft.AspNetCore.* packages |
| `--package` | NuGet package (name or name@version). Repeatable. |
| `--package-prefix` | All packages matching a NuGet ID prefix (e.g., `Azure.AI`) |
| `--library` | Local library file |
| `--project` | Project dependencies via project.assets.json |
| `--bin` | All DLLs in output directory |

Scope flags are combinable: `--platform --package Newtonsoft.Json` searches both.

### diff

Compare API surfaces between versions. Changes are classified as breaking, additive, or potentially breaking.

```bash
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0            # Compact table (default)
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0 -v:d       # Detailed per-member changes
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0 --legend   # Show change marker legend
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0 --breaking # Breaking only
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0 --additive # Additive only
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0 --name-only  # Type names only
dotnet-inspect diff JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.0  # Single type
dotnet-inspect diff "*Writer*" --package Markout@0.1.8..0.2.0            # Glob filter
dotnet-inspect diff JsonSerializer --platform System.Text.Json@8.0.23..10.0.2  # Platform versions
```

Change markers: `+` added, `~` modified (non-breaking), `x` modified (breaking), `-` removed.

### extensions

Find extension methods/properties for a type. Detects both classic extension methods and C# 14 extension properties.

```bash
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient                                 # Default curated scope
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --reachable                     # Include reachable types
dotnet-inspect extensions HttpClient --platform                      # All platform frameworks
dotnet-inspect extensions IServiceCollection \
  --package Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection \
  --package Microsoft.Extensions.Azure                               # Multi-package scan
```

The `--reachable` flag walks the type's API surface to find extensions on types accessible via properties and methods. The `Via` column shows the access path (e.g., `.DeleteAsync().Content` → `HttpContent` extensions).

### implements

Find types implementing an interface or extending a base class.

```bash
dotnet-inspect implements Stream                                     # Default scope
dotnet-inspect implements Stream --platform                          # All platform frameworks
dotnet-inspect implements IDisposable --extensions                   # Microsoft.Extensions packages
dotnet-inspect implements IJsonTypeInfoResolver --package System.Text.Json  # In package
```

### depends

Walk dependency graphs upward. The graph type depends on the input:

```bash
# Type hierarchy — interfaces and base types, recursively
dotnet-inspect depends 'INumber<TSelf>'
dotnet-inspect depends Stream

# Package dependencies — transitive NuGet packages
dotnet-inspect depends --package OpenAI
dotnet-inspect depends --package System.Text.Json --tfm net8.0

# Library references — assembly-level dependencies
dotnet-inspect depends --library System.Numerics
```

### demo

Run curated showcase queries that exercise the tool's capabilities. Each demo prints the equivalent CLI invocation so users can repeat and modify it.

```bash
dotnet-inspect demo                                  # Random pick ("I'm feeling lucky")
dotnet-inspect demo list                             # List all available demos
dotnet-inspect demo 1                                # Run a specific demo by index
dotnet-inspect demo --feeling-lucky                  # Random pick (explicit flag)
```

### samples

Fetch and display code samples for a type from SourceLink-indexed sources.

```bash
dotnet-inspect samples Markout MarkoutWriter --list  # List available samples
dotnet-inspect samples Markout MarkoutWriter         # Print all samples
dotnet-inspect samples Newtonsoft.Json JObject        # Third-party examples
```

Also accessible via `member` command: `dotnet-inspect member Markout MarkoutWriter --samples`

### cache

Manage the dotnet-inspect cache (downloaded ref packs, packages, sources, symbols).

```bash
dotnet-inspect cache                                # Show cache size breakdown
dotnet-inspect cache --clean                        # Clear the cache
```

## LLM Usage Guide

### Default Output is Compact (No Flags Needed)

Default output is compact columnar tables — like `docker images` or `git log --oneline`. No `--oneline` flag is needed for scanning:

```bash
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine         # compact table
dotnet-inspect type --package System.CommandLine                    # compact table
dotnet-inspect find "*Logger*" --platform                           # compact table
```

Use `-v` or `--markdown` when you need rich document output. Use `-v:d` only when you need source code or IL.

### Migration Workflow (fixing build errors from API changes)

When code fails to compile because it uses an outdated API:

```bash
# 1. Identify the version gap (check .csproj PackageReference versions)
# 2. Diff the old and new versions to see all breaking/additive changes
dotnet-inspect diff --package System.CommandLine@2.0.0-beta4.22272.1..2.0.3

# 3. Scan the new type surface
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.3

# 4. Enumerate overloads (--select shows Name:N indices)
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.3 --select

# 5. Drill into a specific overload
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.3 -m SetAction:1
```

Start with `diff` — it immediately shows all removed/changed/added members. This avoids guessing which APIs changed.

### Common Mistakes to Avoid

```bash
# WRONG: Using -v:d for initial scanning (wastes tokens with source/IL)
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine -v:d              # ✗
# CORRECT: Default is compact — use it for scanning, -v:d only for source/IL
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine                   # ✓ (compact table)
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine -m SetAction:1 -v:d # ✓ (source/IL for one overload)

# WRONG: Using empty angle brackets for generic types (resolves to abstract base)
dotnet-inspect member "Option<>" --package System.CommandLine                # ✗ (shows Option, not Option<T>)
# CORRECT: Use <T> to get the concrete generic type with constructors
dotnet-inspect member 'Option<T>' --package System.CommandLine               # ✓ (shows Option<T> with .ctor)

# WRONG: Expecting RootCommand to show inherited members from Command
dotnet-inspect member RootCommand --package System.CommandLine               # only shows RootCommand's own members
# WORKAROUND: Also query the base type to see inherited methods like Add() and SetAction()
dotnet-inspect member Command --package System.CommandLine                    # shows Add(), SetAction(), Parse()

# WRONG: --platform on search commands doesn't take a library name (it's a bool flag)
dotnet-inspect find "IHost*" --platform Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting   # ✗
# CORRECT: Use --package for specific NuGet packages, --extensions for curated set
dotnet-inspect find "IHost*" --package Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting    # ✓
dotnet-inspect find "IHost*" --extensions                              # ✓ (curated set)

# WRONG: Two separate version args for diff
dotnet-inspect diff System.Text.Json@8.0.0 System.Text.Json@9.0.0     # ✗
# CORRECT: Single arg with .. range separator
dotnet-inspect diff System.Text.Json@8.0.0..9.0.0                     # ✓

# WRONG: Running --help to learn syntax (wastes tokens)
dotnet-inspect type --help                                              # ✗
# CORRECT: Use llmstxt for complete syntax reference
dotnet-inspect llmstxt                                                 # ✓

# WRONG: Using -m without the type name
dotnet-inspect member --package Newtonsoft.Json -m SerializeObject     # ✗
# CORRECT: Provide type as positional arg, or use dotted syntax
dotnet-inspect member JsonConvert --package Newtonsoft.Json -m SerializeObject  # ✓
dotnet-inspect member -m JsonConvert.SerializeObject --package Newtonsoft.Json  # ✓

# WRONG: Piping through head/tail/Select-Object to limit output
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json | head -20  # ✗
# CORRECT: Use built-in limiting — preserves headers and formatting
dotnet-inspect member JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -20         # ✓ (line limit)
dotnet-inspect find "*Logger*" -n 5                                         # ✓ (line limit)
```

### Generic Type Syntax

Use C# generic syntax — the tool auto-converts to metadata format:
- `"List<T>"` → `List\`1`
- `"Dictionary<TKey, TValue>"` → `Dictionary\`2`

Quote the type name to prevent shell interpretation: `'Option<T>'`

**Important:** Use `<T>` (not `<>`) to target the concrete generic type. `"Option<>"` resolves to the abstract base `Option`, which hides constructors and generic-specific members.

## Key Options Reference

| Option | Description | Commands |
| ------ | ----------- | -------- |
| `--package` | NuGet package source | type, member, library, find, extensions, implements, depends, diff |
| `--package-prefix` | All packages matching NuGet ID prefix | find, extensions, implements |
| `--platform` | Platform library source (string) / all platform frameworks (bool) | type, member, library, diff (string) / find, extensions, implements, depends (bool) |
| `--extensions` | Curated Microsoft.Extensions.* packages | find, extensions, implements, depends |
| `--aspnetcore` | Curated Microsoft.AspNetCore.* packages | find, extensions, implements, depends |
| `--library` | Local library file | type, member, find, extensions, implements |
| `--tfm net8.0` | Select target framework | package, library, type, member, extensions |
| `-t Pattern` | Filter types by glob pattern | type |
| `-m Name` | Filter to member (supports globs, Type.Member syntax) | member |
| `-k Kind` | Filter by kind (class/struct/interface/enum/delegate or method/property/field/event/constructor) | type, member |
| `-n N` or `-N` | Limit output lines (like `head`) | all commands |
| `--shape` | Type shape diagram (hierarchy + members) | type |
| `--select` | Show Select column with Name:N shorthand | member |
| `--index N` | Target Nth overload (or use Name:N shorthand) | member |
| `--params "..."` | Target overload by parameter types | member |
| `-of Type` | Select overload by first parameter type | member |
| `--docs` | Include XML documentation (on by default for member) | member |
| `--no-docs` | Suppress XML documentation | member |
| `--samples` | Fetch code samples | member |
| `--ctor` | Constructor details (shorthand for -m .ctor) | member |
| `--oneline` | Compact columnar output | type, member, find, diff, implements |
| `--markdown` | Markdown output | all commands |
| `--plaintext` | Plaintext output | all commands |
| `--json` | JSON output | all commands |
| `--no-header` | Suppress column headers | type, member, find, diff, implements |
| `-v:q/m/n/d` | Verbosity (section inclusion) | all commands |
| `-D` | Discover schema (sections, fields, columns) | all commands |
| `-S` | Select section by name (glob-capable) | all commands |
| `--fields` | Project specific fields (glob-capable) | all commands |
| `--columns` | Project specific columns (glob-capable) | all commands |
| `--effective` | Show only sections with data (dry run) | all commands |
| `--tree` | Show discovery as tree (sections → items) | all commands |
| `--dependencies` | Dependency tree (visual) | library, package |
| `--references` | Direct assembly references | library |
| `--source-link-audit` | SourceLink/determinism audit (network) | library |
| `--extract-resources dir/` | Extract embedded resources | library |
| `--versions` | List available versions | package |
| `--version` | Show latest version (or specify version) | package |
| `--files` | List files | package |
| `--tfms` | List target frameworks | package |
| `--layout` | File tree view | package |
| `--readme` | Show README.md from package | package |
| `--reachable` | Include reachable type extensions | extensions |
| `--breaking` | Breaking changes only | diff |
| `--additive` | Additive changes only | diff |
| `--name-only` | Names only | diff |
| `--legend` | Show change marker legend | diff |
| `--all` | Include hidden/obsolete | implements, find |
| `-x Name` | Exclude section | all commands |
| `-T:q/d` | Tips verbosity | all commands |
| `--prerelease` | Include prerelease versions | package --versions |
| `--add-source URL` | Add NuGet source | package |
| `--source URL` | Use specific NuGet source | package |
